en: A black-and-white vintage photograph of a large outdoor theatrical performance, possibly a folk play or pageant, taking place in front of a stone structure with a large arched gate, covered in vines. The stage is framed by tall stone walls and the audience is dressed in early 20th-century fashion, including hats and suits. Some performers on the stage appear to be wearing traditional folk costumes.
